limitations: For duplicate round snapshots a late positive WinEvent is preserved; validity still comes from the battle report.
No WinEvent can include simultaneous deaths and ties. These rows are not automatically certified exclusive losses.
Some rounds lack source hashes or complete per-round data. Historical aggregate reports overlap; deduplication is best effort.
Runtime-failed battles remain invalid and must not be counted as victories.
Current running-battle CSV is a snapshot, not a completed result.
Correlations in energy/walls/skips are diagnostic hypotheses, not proof of causality.
